procedural_matters: FRA 1411 was represented by Nolann Huet des Aunay.
SUI 1132 was represented by Niklas Kaiser.
Prior to the hearing, an arbitration meeting was held; Anastazja Lewandowska (member of the international jury) acted as arbitrator.
FRA 1411 did not ask to withdraw the protest after the arbitration meeting and neither boat took a Post-Race Penalty under RRS T1(a).
Lorenz Kausche (crew of SUI 1808) gave evidence as a witness for SUI 1132.
The panel of the international jury presented tracking evidence.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were 6 knots of wind and small chop.
FRA 1411 and SUI 1132 entered the zone of mark 1 for the second rounding on starboard tack, on a close-hauled course, with FRA 1411 overlapped approximately 1 boat length to windward of SUI 1132.
At the mark, SUI 1132, sailing below the layline, luffed and the distance between SUI 1132 and FRA 1411 decreased to approximately 1 metre.
There was contact between the port side of SUI 1132’s hull and the mark for approximately 3 seconds, causing the mark to turn and drift to leeward.
conclusions: SUI 1132 touched mark 1 and broke RRS 31.
